featureDefinitions.category_affinity: Sigmoid-normalized weighted behavior score using only prior events.
featureDefinitions.average_category_watch_percentage: Mean watch percentage for all prior category watches.
featureDefinitions.recent_category_watch_percentage: Mean category watch percentage in the previous 30 days.
featureDefinitions.category_completion_rate: Completed category watches divided by prior category watches.
featureDefinitions.recent_category_completion_rate: Completion rate for category watches in the previous 30 days.
featureDefinitions.category_positive_count: Prior labeled positive interactions in the category.
featureDefinitions.category_negative_count: Prior negative or not-interested interactions in the category.
featureDefinitions.creator_interaction_count: Prior interactions between the user and candidate creator.
featureDefinitions.creator_completion_rate: Prior completion rate for the candidate creator.
featureDefinitions.creator_followed: Whether the user followed the candidate creator before scoring.
featureDefinitions.content_popularity_score: Candidate catalog popularity in [0,1], identical online and offline.
featureDefinitions.content_age_hours: Hours from catalog creation to scoring timestamp.
featureDefinitions.already_seen: Whether the user interacted with this content before scoring.
featureDefinitions.days_since_last_category_interaction: Days since prior category activity, capped at 365.
